question: [Q10] What are the most promising radiometric techniques for the measurement of minor actinides in nuclear safeguard applications?

accepted_answer.value: X-ray fluorescence analysis (XRF), passive neutron coincidence counting (PNCC), high-resolution gamma spectrometry (HRGS) and calorimetry

suggested_answers.value: X-ray fluorescence analysis (XRF), passive neutron coincidence counting (PNCC), high-resolution gamma spectrometry (HRGS) and calorimetry

supporting_evidence.text: Among the radiometric techniques developed and utilized for safeguards in the conventional fuel cycle the techniques of X-ray fluorescence analysis (XRF), passive neutron coincidence counting (PNCC), high-resolution gamma spectrometry (HRGS) and calorimetry show the most promising potential for applications in minor actinide assay.
